evidence.name: Screen field: How the text lines up
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How the text lines up" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How the text lines up
sections.description: Lines up the placeholder and typed text to the left, center, or right (default center). Left is the most familiar for input fields and the easiest to scan, while center suits short, decorative prompts. Pick whichever keeps the answer clearly readable for what you're collecting.
